assets.identity: Official generic SIGKDD full logo with broad black KDD wordmark, cyan and blue geometric motif, white background
assets.transformation: Lossless WebP encoding of the decoded official JPEG. No resizing, cropping, recoloring, redrawing, or rearrangement. Full original boundaries and white background preserved.
assets.inspected: Viewed downloaded original. Large black KDD starts near y449 of796, equivalent to97px at172px canvas height; full geometric motif fills left and wraps top. This placement closely matches the user reference.
assets.replaces: Earlier kdd.webp in this folder used a different, thin-letter official2014 variant. Current kdd.webp uses the wide-letter ACM RecSys source.
